recent_news.headline: Kitchen Carbon Offsets: What §45Z Makes Your Grease Worth
recent_news.summary: Under the Inflation Reduction Act's §45Z Clean Fuel Production Credit, recycled cooking oil biodiesel can earn up to $0.70 per gallon in federal tax credits when prevailing wage rules are met. The analysis shows California could unlock roughly $32 million in annual credit value from UCO recycling.

recent_news.headline: The sustainable aviation fuel cost premium is permanent—Here's what that means
recent_news.summary: HEFA from waste oils is the cheapest SAF pathway, but waste oil supply is finite and competes with renewable diesel. The article discusses how used cooking oil and tallow face competition between renewable diesel and SAF producers for limited feedstock supply.
